sentences.text:
Gopal Das Mahor vs Shankarlal Mahor on 13 September, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:15761
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 13th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 26567 of 2024
 Gopal Das Mahor
 Versus
 Shankarlal Mahor
 Appearance:
 Shri Achyuth Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Asad Khan - Advocate for the respondent.

Order 
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 482 of B.N.S.S.(438 of CrPC) for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with RCT 2943/2024 for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 and 120-B of IPC.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is 62 years old and he is suffering from various ailments regarding which he has filed the documents along-with I.A.No.18090/2024.

It is also submitted that the cognizance was taken by the trial Court on the basis of the judgment dated 16.07.2012 of Civil Court wherein Will dated 30.12.2003 was found to be false and fabricated and it is found that there was cutting and overwriting in the Will, thereupon in 2022 a private complaint has been filed by the respondent against the present applicant.
No sufficient explanation has been offered for delay.
It is also submitted that it is a civil matter and the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15761 2 MCRC-26567-2024 matter was heard finally in 2012, but the private complaint has been filed.
Hence, learned counsel prays to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer and submits that right from beginning the respondent knew about the false and fabricated Will dated 30.12.2003 and he has filed various complaints to the Police for taking action against the present applicant but Police did not take any action against the present applicant thereafter, in 2022 the complaint was filed and vide order dated 13.05.2024 learned trial Court has taken cognizance of offence under Section 420,
467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC against the present applicant, therefore, no case is made out for grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and that Will was allegedly executed on 30.12.2003 and this complaint has been filed in 2022, the applicant is aged about 62 years and suffering from various ailments, no copy of previous complaints has been filed, this Court is inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Thus, the application is allowed.
However, in case of breach of any of the precondition of bail, the Trial Court may consider on merit cancellation of bail without any impediment of this order.
The trial Court shall get these conditions reproduced on the personal bond by the accused and on surety bond by the surety concerned.
If any of them is unable to write, the scribe shall certify that he had explained the conditions to the concerned accused or the surety.
C.C. as per rules

.
